title: Who negotiates the first offer?
hook: Two stated cases: explore the denominator behind a reported negotiation gap.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the denominator behind a reported negotiation gap affects the stated comparison
